verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 is sandbox infrastructure that runs the user's own AI agents, for example as a backend for the OpenAI Agents SDK or LangChain Deep Agents. A built-in assistant is still a fair question for a developer platform like this, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party AI assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to. Hosting external agents is a building block or adjacent capability and earns no credit.
